jobs.tierReason: review of ticket ledger, approval and change-order logic that gates what the swarm builds and merges
jobs.prompt: Review Phase 13 (scope to tickets to swarm). Design: docs/plans/phase13-design.md. The new CLI glue is tools/scope-commands.mjs; the wiring diff is coordination/review/phase13.diff. Rules that must hold: (1) go --scope never runs an unapproved ledger and never runs when the scope file changed after approval; (2) approval needs the owner's --yes unless the approval policy says otherwise, and an unknown or malformed policy fails closed; (3) split jobs and tickets that touch the Sensitive list are sensitive and never routed to rented, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini or Lambda lanes; (4) the ledger and log writes cannot escape the project (symlinks, absolute or .. paths in ticket files, context or contracts, scope file argument); (5) ticket state moves are only the legal ones, a done ticket changes only by a change order, nothing goes ready before its dependencies are done; (6) a malicious or broken worker output in a split file (huge, wrong types, prototype keys, duplicate keys, ids or paths that escape) is refused without writing a ledger; (7) change orders never delete history and cannot be applied without --yes; (8) generated contract code (mock server, client, validators, tests) cannot be made to run attacker code or write outside its folder by a hostile OpenAPI file (names, paths, enum values, descriptions placed into generated source). Find real bugs with file and line evidence, rank high, medium, low, and say how to fix each. Do not edit files.
